changelog:
- Universal Skippable Video Ad Blocker: Instantly eliminates preroll video ads across adult tube platforms (MindGeek, TrafficJunky, ExoClick) and streaming players (FluidPlayer, VideoJS, JWPlayer, IMA SDK).
- Real-Time Skip Trigger & Countdown Bypass: Removes artificial countdown delays, unlocks disabled skip buttons, and automatically completes prerolls without human interaction.
- Network-Level VAST / VPAID XML Ad Defuser: Synthesizes empty VAST 3.0 XML responses to short-circuit video ad auction requests before media streams are downloaded.
- Editorial & Social Video Protection: Zero interference with news article clips, social feeds (X / Twitter, Instagram, Reddit), or regular media playback.
- YouTube uBO Standard Retained: Zero playback rate or buffering glitches on YouTube.
- Pure Android System WebView v2.2.2 release (17.4 MB).
